name: progress
title: Progress
description: Displays the status of a task that takes a long time.

files.content:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Progress as ProgressPrimitive } from '@shardsui/svelte/progress';
  import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  type Props = Omit<ComponentProps<typeof ProgressPrimitive.Indicator>, 'children'> & {
    children?: Snippet;
  };

  let { class: className, children, ...restProps }: Props = $props();
</script>

<ProgressPrimitive.Indicator
  class={cn(
    'h-full bg-primary transition-all duration-500 data-indeterminate:w-full data-indeterminate:animate-indeterminate-progress',
    className
  )}
  data-slot="progress-indicator"
  {...restProps}
>
  {@render children?.()}
</ProgressPrimitive.Indicator>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Progress as ProgressPrimitive } from '@shardsui/svelte/progress';
  import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  type Props = Omit<ComponentProps<typeof ProgressPrimitive.Label>, 'children'> & {
    children?: Snippet;
  };

  let { class: className, children, ...restProps }: Props = $props();
</script>

<ProgressPrimitive.Label
  class={cn('font-medium text-foreground text-sm', className)}
  data-slot="progress-label"
  {...restProps}
>
  {@render children?.()}
</ProgressPrimitive.Label>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Progress as ProgressPrimitive } from '@shardsui/svelte/progress';
  import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  type Props = Omit<ComponentProps<typeof ProgressPrimitive.Track>, 'children'> & {
    children?: Snippet;
  };

  let { class: className, children, ...restProps }: Props = $props();
</script>

<ProgressPrimitive.Track
  class={cn('block h-1.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-input', className)}
  data-slot="progress-track"
  {...restProps}
>
  {@render children?.()}
</ProgressPrimitive.Track>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Progress as ProgressPrimitive } from '@shardsui/svelte/progress';
  import type { ComponentProps } from 'svelte';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  let { class: className, ...restProps }: ComponentProps<typeof ProgressPrimitive.Value> = $props();
</script>

<ProgressPrimitive.Value
  class={cn('text-foreground text-sm tabular-nums', className)}
  data-slot="progress-value"
  {...restProps}
>
  {#snippet children(formatted)}
    {formatted === 'indeterminate' ? '—' : formatted}
  {/snippet}
</ProgressPrimitive.Value>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Progress as ProgressPrimitive } from '@shardsui/svelte/progress';
  import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';
  import ProgressIndicator from './progress-indicator.svelte';
  import ProgressTrack from './progress-track.svelte';

  type Props = Omit<ComponentProps<typeof ProgressPrimitive.Root>, 'children'> & {
    children?: Snippet;
  };

  let { class: className, value = 0, min = 0, max = 100, children, ...restProps }: Props = $props();
</script>

<ProgressPrimitive.Root
  class={cn('flex w-full flex-col gap-2', className)}
  data-slot="progress"
  {value}
  {min}
  {max}
  {...restProps}
>
  {#if children}
    {@render children()}
  {:else}
    <ProgressTrack>
      <ProgressIndicator />
    </ProgressTrack>
  {/if}
</ProgressPrimitive.Root>
